sources.name: Nintendo Life — Complete Pokédex and habitats

field_conflicts.specialties: Serebii lists Chop; Nintendo Life lists Search. The second specialty is withheld pending further verification.

field_notes.specialties: No specialty is listed by the reviewed references.

field_notes.habitats: The reviewed references do not list a habitat requirement for Ditto.

field_notes.specialties: Serebii and Pokopia Guide list Hype. Nintendo Life displays “Volbeat” in the Specialty column, which appears to be a transcription error.

field_notes.variants: Community references use both Peakychu and Pale Pikachu for the special #079 variant; it is kept separate from standard Pikachu conditions.

field_notes.habitats: Pokopia Guide additionally lists Red Tall Grass; that extra habitat is withheld until another reviewed source confirms it.

pokemon.name: Munchlax
habitats: Bed With a Plush (Palette Town only)

field_notes.variants: Mosslax is a story variant and is kept separate from standard Snorlax habitat conditions.

field_notes.forms: Community references use Smearguru and Decorator for this Pokopia-specific Smeargle presentation.

field_notes.name: Nintendo Life spells the name “Pelliper”; Bulbapedia, Serebii, and the National Pokédex spelling confirm Pelipper.

field_notes.habitats: Nintendo Life spells the first habitat “Tableside Deilvery Cart”; Pokopia Guide confirms the corrected spelling.

field_notes.name: Nintendo Life spells the name “Graveller”; Bulbapedia, Serebii, and the National Pokédex spelling confirm Graveler.

field_conflicts.specialties: Serebii and Nintendo Life list DJ; Pokopia Guide lists Hype. DJ is retained because two reviewed sources agree.

field_notes.name: Nintendo Life spells the name “Rowlett”; Bulbapedia, Serebii, and the National Pokédex spelling confirm Rowlet.

field_notes.specialties: Serebii and Nintendo Life confirm Party. Pokopia Guide's Hype listing is not used.

field_conflicts.habitats: Nintendo Life additionally lists Pointy Tree-shaded Rocky Tall Grass; Pokopia Guide instead lists Best Bread Bakery. Only the shared Graceful Flower Bed is published.
Nintendo Life lists Best Bread Bakery; Pokopia Guide lists Piping-hot Lava. The habitat is withheld pending another reviewed source.

Serebii and Pokopia Guide list Burn and Trade; Nintendo Life lists only Burn.

field_conflicts.specialties: Serebii and Pokopia Guide list Gather only; Nintendo Life additionally lists Build. Build is withheld because the other reviewed sources do not corroborate it.

field_conflicts.habitats: Nintendo Life additionally lists Fireplace Nap Spot; Pokopia Guide lists only Concrete Pipe Secret Base. Only the shared habitat is published.

field_conflicts.specialties: Nintendo Life and Serebii list Gather and Trade; Pokopia Guide lists Gather and Search. Gather and Trade are retained because two reviewed sources agree.

field_conflicts.habitats: Pokopia Guide additionally lists Sewer-hole Inspection; Nintendo Life lists only the two Palette Town habitats. The uncorroborated extra habitat is withheld.

field_notes.forms: Nintendo Life calls the story-specific Tinkaton Tinkmaster; Bulbapedia labels the same Pokopia presentation Supervisor. It is kept separate from ordinary Tinkaton data.

field_notes.specialties: Serebii's ??? label means Kyogre has no specialty.
field_notes.habitats: Kyogre is obtained through story progression rather than a habitat.

pokemon.name: Raikou
pokemon.acquisition: Use the Pikachu Doll to search the underground area of an Ocean Dream Island after the required story progress.

field_notes.habitats: Raikou is a Dream Island encounter rather than a habitat arrival.

pokemon.name: Entei
pokemon.acquisition: Use the Arcanine Doll to search the underground area of a Volcanic Dream Island.

field_notes.habitats: Entei is a Dream Island encounter rather than a habitat arrival.

pokemon.name: Suicune
pokemon.acquisition: Use the Eevee Doll to search the underground area of a Wasteland Dream Island.

field_notes.habitats: Suicune is a Dream Island encounter rather than a habitat arrival.

pokemon.name: Volcanion
pokemon.acquisition: Finish the Rocky Ridges story, then hold another successful party there to invite Volcanion.

field_notes.habitats: Volcanion is obtained through the Rocky Ridges story and party request rather than a habitat.

pokemon.name: Articuno
pokemon.acquisition: Build the Freezing Chambers kit in Palette Town.

field_notes.habitats: Articuno is unlocked by a Palette Town building kit rather than a habitat.

pokemon.name: Zapdos
pokemon.acquisition: Build the Abandoned Power Plant kit in Palette Town.

field_notes.habitats: Zapdos is unlocked by a Palette Town building kit rather than a habitat.

pokemon.name: Moltres
pokemon.acquisition: Build the Altar of the Flame kit in Palette Town.

field_notes.habitats: Moltres is unlocked by a Palette Town building kit rather than a habitat.

pokemon.name: Lugia
pokemon.acquisition: Befriend Articuno, Zapdos, and Moltres; craft the Tidal Bell with Rare PokéMetal and Silver Feathers, then ring it while Lugia is overhead.

field_notes.specialties: Serebii's ??? label means Lugia has no specialty.
field_notes.habitats: Lugia is called with the Tidal Bell rather than attracted by a habitat.
field_notes.number: Nintendo Life swaps Lugia and Ho-Oh at #297/#298; Bulbapedia, Serebii, and Pokopia Guide confirm Lugia is #297.

pokemon.name: Ho-Oh
pokemon.acquisition: Befriend Raikou, Entei, and Suicune; craft the Clear Bell with Rare PokéMetal and Rainbow Feathers, then ring it while Ho-Oh is overhead.

field_notes.specialties: Serebii's ??? label means Ho-Oh has no specialty.
field_notes.habitats: Ho-Oh is called with the Clear Bell rather than attracted by a habitat.
field_notes.number: Nintendo Life swaps Lugia and Ho-Oh at #297/#298; Bulbapedia, Serebii, and Pokopia Guide confirm Ho-Oh is #298.

pokemon.name: Mewtwo
pokemon.acquisition: Complete the Sparkling Skylands story; Mewtwo can also be encountered underground on a Sky Dream Island using the Dragonite Doll.

field_notes.habitats: Mewtwo is obtained through story progress or a Dream Island encounter rather than a habitat.

pokemon.name: Mew
pokemon.acquisition: Collect all 27 Mysterious Slates and place them correctly in the underground mural behind the Withered Wastelands Pokémon Center.

field_notes.habitats: Mew is unlocked by the Mysterious Slate puzzle rather than a habitat.
